title: ChargePoint Home Flex wpa_passphrase Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-131817)
description: A command injection vulnerability exists in the ChargePoint Home Flex EV charger within the wpa_passphrase endpoint's PSK parameter. This flaw allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code as root without authentication. The vulnerability arises from improper validation of user-supplied input used in a system call.
